text:
mira: Quick heads-up — onboarded reranker v2 (gptish-small) with PTQ pipeline.
henry: Nice. initial perf?
sophie: ran eval harness on legal/casepairs holdout.
eval-bot: RUN 5001234567 — metrics: ndcg@10=0.842 -> 0.828 (drop 1.7%), mrr=0.612 -> 0.605
mira: ugh small but consistent drop on legal; other datasets stable.
dan: can you paste the eval command and seed?
mira: command:
```
./eval_harness --model rerank-v2-ptq --dataset legal/casepairs --seed 42 --metric ndcg@10
```
mira: seed 42, batch 64. quant params: 4-bit per-channel PTQ with outlier clamp.
tia: any difference in query/doc formatting between onboard and prod harness?
sophie: good q — prod ingestion strips HTML & collapses whitespace; our eval samples retain raw snippets with inline <b> tags.
henry: that could explain it. HTML tags can shift tokenization and pairwise relevance in short queries.
mira: quick check: when I normalize (html->text, collapse spaces) ndcg jumps back to 0.839 in a local run.
dan: do we have a standard canonicalizer for evals? if not, we should add one to onboarding checklist.
sophie: propose: canonicalize at two points — (1) dataset-prep canonicalized_text field, (2) model input preprocessor config flag to allow toggling. Also add sample diff in report.
henry: agree. also add small A/B where we run PTQ model on canonicalized vs raw to measure sensitivity.
mira: ok will do. i'll run A/B across three cohorts (short <8 tokens, mid 8-32, long >32) and post results.
tia: add test in CI harness: fail if ndcg drop >1.0% on canonicalized path vs float baseline.
dan: +1. also log tokenizer token counts before/after canonicalize.
eval-bot: A/B queued: job 5001234567-ab1 created.
mira: thanks — I'll post a short doc with commands and results when done. :thumbsup:
